comments.author: Kom
comments.body_html:
You can use the official offline save editor from the SPT team. Just max out Bot Sound in the skills section. This will make your running and walking sounds inaudible even at full volume.

You will still make noise when stepping on broken glass or vaulting over obstacles, but those sounds will no longer affect you.
